clue.text: Circuits broken by it, a retrospective in 3-D

indicators.note: looking back, so the whole assembly is read from right to left
the circuits word is split open with the other words set inside it

parts.note: laps are circuits of a track

explanation.surface: An art retrospective shown in three dimensions, with gallery circuits interrupted by it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it, a' goes inside LAPS to make LAITAPS, and 'retrospective' turns all of that round.
explanation.definitionFit: Something in 3-D occupies space, which is what the adjective for space describes.

clue.text: Sad expiry with a fever

indicators.note: sad is taken in the sense of sorry or wretched, a state that signals the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A grim death that came with a high temperature.
explanation.definitionFit: Medical term for a raised body temperature, the clinical synonym of fever.

clue.text: That is to say, to woo follows naturally

definitions.meaning: a formal phrase introducing a clarification, like 'namely'
the owl's call in its traditional spelling has the 'to woo' half following this first half

explanation.surface: Courtship is supposed to come naturally, so to speak.
explanation.walkthrough: The owl's hoot is traditionally written as two halves, the second being 'to-woo'; Shakespeare's song in Love's Labour's Lost has it.
explanation.definitionFit: A legal-sounding synonym of namely, introducing a specification of what was just said.

clue.text: Star fiddling with gift weapon, initially

indicators.note: fiddling suggests messing about with the letters until they are reordered

parts.note: a lance is a knight's long spear

explanation.surface: A celebrity messing with a gift of a weapon at the beginning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fiddling with' works on the two words either side of it; 'weapon' then supplies the knight's spear.
explanation.definitionFit: On first impression and at the very start are equivalent senses of the adverb initially.

clue.text: Musical greeting included in reservations

indicators.note: the greeting sits within the musical's name

parts.note: Cats is the Lloyd Webber musical
ave is the Latin hail, as in Ave Maria

explanation.surface: Having doubts about a sung hello.
explanation.definitionFit: Caveats are warnings or provisos, which is what reservations about something amount to.

clue.text: The same for an entry for 19 people, say

indicators.note: an entry is a going in, so the little word goes inside the phrase for 'the same'

parts.note: 'as is' means unchanged, exactly the same as before

explanation.surface: A repeat clue entry for a group of people from the earlier answer.
explanation.walkthrough: 19 is INDONESIA, so '19 people, say' are Indonesians, an example of the broader group. 'The same' gives AS IS, and 'an' enters it after the I.
explanation.definitionFit: Indonesians are one example of people from the largest continent, hence the 'say'.

clue.text: Surface to back talk and disappear

indicators.note: sending the word backwards, so it is read from its end

parts.note: to pave is to surface a road
orate means to talk at length, make a speech

explanation.surface: An instruction to cover a road, retreat, chat and then vanish.
explanation.definitionFit: Liquids that turn to vapour vanish, so the verb is used figuratively for vanishing.

clue.text: Bananas off one's shopping in here

definitions.meaning: fill-in-the-blank: 'off one's ___' is an idiom meaning crazy, as bananas does
a supermarket cart holds the shopping

explanation.surface: Fruit removed from a basket of groceries.
explanation.walkthrough: The first half is a phrase to complete: being 'off one's' cart means being mad, which is what 'bananas' means in slang.
explanation.definitionFit: A wheeled supermarket cart carries purchases, and 'off one's cart' is British slang for crazy.

clue.text: Therapist of the nose? Pay attention to include wise report about that

indicators.note: the hiss opens to take in the rest

parts.note: psst is the hiss used to get someone to pay attention

indicators.note: the sounded pair goes round 'that', the adjective of the nose
report means the word is as it sounds when spoken, like the plural of a letter of the alphabet

parts.note: the word wise is what is spoken
choanal is the adjective from choana, the internal nostril

explanation.surface: A shrink specialising in noses, with a whispered hush and some clever comment.
explanation.walkthrough: Said out loud, 'wise' is Y's, two Ys; they surround CHOANAL, a rare anatomical adjective for the nostrils, and 'to include' puts the lot inside the hiss.
explanation.definitionFit: A Freudian practitioner who treats patients through talking therapy is one kind of therapist.

clue.text: Hector and Bob mixed with water

indicators.note: mixed signals the letters are stirred together and rearranged

explanation.surface: Two men named Hector and Bob in a cocktail with water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hector' looks like a name beside 'Bob', but it is the verb to bully.
explanation.definitionFit: To hector someone is to bully them with words, intimidate them into compliance.

clue.text: Headgear fashionable to Africans

indicators.note: fashion in the sense of shaping, so the letters are reshaped into a new order

explanation.surface: Hats that are in style for people from Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: A small decorative headpiece worn at weddings and races, an example of headwear.

clue.text: Indiscrete xenophobia covers reactionary city

indicators.note: reactionary as in going back, so the held letters run backwards
the two words cover the letters needed, held within them

explanation.surface: Tactless fear of foreigners hides a right-wing town.
explanation.definitionFit: A cathedral city in Devon in the south-west of England.

clue.text: Loves to sit together in romantic light to do this?

definitions.text: Loves to sit together in romantic light to do this?

indicators.note: the pair of Os is placed side by side inside the light

parts.note: a candle gives the soft light of a romantic dinner
love is zero in tennis, which looks like O, so two loves are two Os

explanation.surface: Lovers sitting close by candlelight, wondering if this is what they should be doing.
explanation.definitionFit: Kissing and cuddling amorously is what courting couples do by candlelight.

clue.text: "Feeling" in a laptop programme

indicators.note: to programme is to arrange or set in order, so the letters are reprogrammed

explanation.surface: An emotion appearing in a computer program.
explanation.definitionFit: Doctors examine by touch, and this medical term means such feeling with the hands.

clue.text: Perhaps his topic includes a principle for reduced consumption of nuts

definitions.text: principle for reduced consumption of nuts

indicators.note: the rearranged words take in the a
perhaps hints that the letters could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Someone's subject is a dietary rule for eating fewer nuts.
explanation.walkthrough: The empty shells of these nuts remind snackers how many they have eaten, so they eat fewer; this is called the pistachio principle.
explanation.definitionFit: Named after the green nut whose discarded shells cue diners to cut back, a behavioural eating idea.

clue.text: It's a tyranny of the flesh that describes him

definitions.text: It's a tyranny of the flesh that describes him

indicators.note: describe in the sense of drawing a line round, so the words enclose the letters

explanation.surface: A lustful creature is defined by being ruled by bodily desire.
explanation.definitionFit: The goat-legged woodland god of Greek myth, a byword for a lecherous man.

clue.text: That's what you get from bad diets

indicators.note: bad as in spoilt or wrong, signalling that the letters are disordered

explanation.surface: The result of poor eating plans.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase abbreviated i.e. means that is, which is what 'That's' expands to.

clue.text: Laura and Dick, oddly out for the count

indicators.note: out as in out of order, so the letters are rearranged
take the odd-numbered letters, the first and third

explanation.surface: A couple knocked out cold in a boxing ring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out for the count' reads as a boxing knockout, but 'out' is the anagram signal and 'the count' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Bram Stoker's vampire is a Transylvanian nobleman titled Count.

clue.text: One's invaded some country or another

indicators.note: the first piece enters inside the country

parts.note: India is a country
one's taken as the plural ones, letters O N E S

explanation.surface: Someone's troops have entered one nation or other.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some country' gives INDIA, and 'another' is the definition: a second country.
explanation.definitionFit: The south-east Asian archipelago nation is a second country beside the first one named.

clue.text: Bush having gone, returned

parts.note: out means away, gone from home
back means having come home again

explanation.surface: A US President who left office and then came back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bush' looks like the president's name; it is Australia's wild interior.
explanation.definitionFit: The remote Australian interior is called the bush or the outback.

clue.text: Compiler's complexion charge

parts.note: the compiler is the setter, I, and compiler's is I am, contracted IM
a peaches-and-cream complexion, so peach stands for skin colouring

explanation.surface: The setter's skin tone is being billed.
explanation.definitionFit: To formally accuse a public official of misconduct is to charge them.

clue.text: See 4
Line from Pearl Jam covers the lot

indicators.note: the jumbled letters surround the other piece
a jam is a mess or tangle, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: the lot means everything, all

explanation.surface: A lyric by the American rock band Pearl Jam that sums everything up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jam' looks like part of the band's name but is the anagram signal; the jumbled band word then 'covers' the lot.
explanation.definitionFit: A line of latitude on a map is a parallel, an imaginary circle round the globe.

clue.text: Players and posers can be preposterous

indicators.note: the long word's letters can be rearranged to make the answer together with the posers

explanation.surface: Actors and people who strike poses can be absurd.
explanation.walkthrough: PREPOSTEROUS minus the letters of POSERS leaves letters that rearrange to the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A company of actors or performers travelling together, a group of players.

clue.text: One has an eye for a revolutionary path

definitions.meaning: the bony socket of the skull holds an eye
the circular route of a planet or satellite as it revolves

explanation.surface: Someone with an eye for a radical road.
explanation.definitionFit: The eye socket and a planet's circuit share the same anatomical and astronomical name.

clue.text: Young 6 said to be ending life

indicators.note: spoken aloud, the phrase sounds like the answer

parts.note: young people of the continent are youth in Asia

explanation.surface: Young people from that continent are reportedly dying.
explanation.definitionFit: Assisted dying, the deliberate ending of a patient's life to relieve suffering.

clue.text: See 10
I, for one, having a record, chicken out

indicators.note: the chicken word goes outside the other pieces

parts.note: a hen is a female chicken
a log is a record, as a ship's log

explanation.surface: Someone with a criminal record loses their nerve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chicken out' reads as losing nerve; here 'out' puts HEN outside A LOG. I is the chemical symbol for iodine.
explanation.definitionFit: Iodine, chemical symbol I, belongs to group 17 of the periodic table with fluorine and chlorine.

clue.text: Create an image in blue that is lacking definition

indicators.note: the picture-making word goes inside the colour word

parts.note: the sky is blue
to etch is to make a picture by engraving

explanation.surface: Drawing a picture on a blue background that turns out vague.
explanation.definitionFit: Something vague or lacking detail, like a rough outline drawing.
